title: CCI Approves Tata Steel’s TM International Logistics Stake Buy

blocks.content: The Competition Commission of India approved Tata Steel Limited’s acquisition of an additional 23% equity stake in TM International Logistics Limited on 18 August 2026. The transaction involves Tata Steel buying the entire 23% holding from IQ Martrade Holding Und Management GmbH, which will exit TM International Logistics after the deal.

items: The Competition Commission of India is the statutory competition regulator in India under the Competition Act, 2002.
TM International Logistics Limited is associated with logistics services such as railway cargo transportation, port operations, and freight forwarding.
Tata Steel is one of India’s major integrated steel producers and is listed on both the BSE and NSE.
NYK (Europe) B.V. is part of the shareholding structure of TM International Logistics after the transaction.
